pre_execution_questions.question: For each of the five result products, what exact runtime artifacts are authoritative inputs?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Projection correctness depends on an explicit truth surface.

pre_execution_questions.question: Which products are persisted versus deterministically derived on read, and why?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Persistence changes identity, freshness, invalidation and reproducibility.

pre_execution_questions.question: What is the canonical freshness/invalidation policy and how is it versioned?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Current State and Health cannot be reliable without one policy.

pre_execution_questions.question: Which measurement/economics/claim histories must become first-class runtime stores before projections are possible?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Some concepts currently exist mainly as schemas/workbook surfaces.

pre_execution_questions.question: How will every projected result record builder version, input refs and reversible lineage?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: AX25 requires results to trace back to runtime truth.

pre_execution_questions.question: How should query UCs respond to stale/insufficient/not-comparable inputs without silently mutating research state?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Read-side purity must survive real implementation.

pre_execution_questions.question: How will ChangeSet and TrendSeries reuse one compatibility model instead of diverging?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Duplicate comparability rules would create contradictory user results.

pre_execution_questions.question: If caching is introduced, can it be proven semantically transparent and non-mutating to research truth?
pre_execution_questions.why_it_matters: Performance optimization must not change query meaning.

notes: Prospective question set captured before implementation. Blocking questions must be answered or explicitly made not-applicable before acceptance.
